# Outposts

Player-built bases on planets: found one with an Outpost Console, build on it, save it to your character and bring it
back in a later round, spawn there, and defend it from night raids. Nothing is implemented yet; `PLAN.md` holds the
build order, and the design doc belongs next to it as `DESIGN.md`.
